email.subject: Certificate of Participation - DroidVerse: Android Development Workshop
email.body_text:
Dear {name},

Thanks for participating in the event DroidVerse: Android Development Workshop.

Please find the Participation Certificate and Certificate ID attached below.

Certificate ID: {verify_id}.

You can verify your certificate by visiting https://verify.prmitr.in. Just enter the Certificate ID given in this email. You may also find the same Certificate ID printed on your certificate.

If your verification takes longer than expected, try: Clearing browser cache and cookies, try changing the device, or try on your friends devices.

Feel free to share your achievement on social media.

Regards,
Team GDG On Campus,
PRMIT&R
